$comment: Spec 19 R19-11 Markdown line-cap exemptions. Enforced by scripts/check_doc_length.py. Every entry MUST name a scope class (immutable-record | dated-snapshot) and a written reason. An entry naming a file that is gone, or that is no longer over 500 lines, is a VIOLATION — the list may not rot into a blanket. The release tree (docs outside archive/, mcp-server/, ide/, docs/designs/, docs/reboot/, docs/security/) is enforced with no exemptions.
